caption: The drawing depicts a tall, lidded pitcher or tankard with a prominent, ornate handle on the right side and a gently flared base. The pitcher is rendered in shades of gray pencil on a light beige or off-white background. The lid of the pitcher is domed and topped with an elongated finial. Below the main illustration are six smaller, technical sketches in a row, each showing measured diagrams or details of components of the pitcher, including its top view, base curve, handle profile, and sectional views. The measurements are marked on each technical sketch. The overall composition centers on the realistically shaded, larger pitcher, surrounded by a rectangular frame, with the smaller orthographic and detail views beneath it arranged horizontally.
title: Pewter Flagon
